**Use `time.UnixMilli` for the epoch branch.**

`epochMillis/1000` discards the millisecond remainder. Integer division also truncates toward zero, so negative epoch values move forward in time. `time.UnixMilli` handles both cases and states the unit in the call.

<details>
<summary>♻️ Proposed refactor</summary>

```diff
 	if epochMillis, err := strconv.ParseInt(value, 10, 64); err == nil {
-		fromEpoch := time.Unix(epochMillis/1000, 0)
+		fromEpoch := time.UnixMilli(epochMillis)
 		return &fromEpoch, true
 	}
```
</details>
